visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey cable-knit turtleneck sweater, sits on a high yellow stool in a bright indoor environment. She holds a white and black modern game controller, looking at a large television screen displaying a colorful action video game. The background features a kitchen-like counter with various items and a bright overhead light. (2) The camera zooms in to a medium close-up of the woman as she turns toward the viewer, speaking with an expressive facial expression. Mathematical symbols and formulas as white graphics float around her against a blurred background. (3) She holds a white rectangular object, possibly a product box, while green and white text boxes appear on the screen listing technical resolutions. The lighting remains bright and consistent. (4) The scene shifts to a direct screen capture or close-up of a TV menu interface with several icons like a globe and a speaker. A cursor highlights the 'Screen and Video' option, then transitions to a blue and black screen showing white technical text. (5) Returning to the woman on the stool, she points towards the television while holding the controller. A yellow and white text box displays numerical resolution values. (6) A hand enters from the right side of the frame reaching towards the woman's controller. She pulls away with a playful, defensive posture. A cartoon dog head with red 'anger' symbols briefly overlays her face as she reacts.
